eyebrow: Why it's worse for AI specifically
code:
Web service cold start:  roughly 1-5 seconds

AI service cold start:   roughly 30s - 2+ minutes
  (multi-GB image pull + multi-GB model load
   into GPU memory)
caption: A user who triggers this isn't waiting a second -- they're waiting long enough to leave.

code:
1. Min-instances floor above zero
   -> pay for idle capacity around the clock
2. Pre-warm / provisioned concurrency
   -> still idle cost, plus complexity
3. Smaller / quantized model weights
   -> a real quality trade-off, not just infra
caption: None make cold starts disappear -- each trades money, complexity, or quality for less delay.

subtitle: Avoiding the expensive work entirely, when you can.
